IF EXISTS
    (SELECT *
     FROM [sys].[objects] o
     WHERE [o].[type] = 'U'
     AND [o].[is_ms_shipped] = 0
     AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT *
         FROM [sys].[extended_properties] AS [ep]
         WHERE [ep].[major_id] = [o].[object_id]
             AND [ep].[minor_id] = 0
             AND [ep].[class] = 1
             AND [ep].[name] = N'microsoft_database_tools_support'
    )
)
SELECT 1 ELSE SELECT 0

    WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM [PlatformSettings] AS [p]) THEN CAST(1 AS bit)
    ELSE CAST(0 AS bit)
END

        SELECT 1
        FROM [MainSettingHeaders] AS [m]) THEN CAST(1 AS bit)

CREATE TABLE [MainSettings] (
    [Id] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL,
    [WebLogo] nvarchar(max) NULL,
    [WebTitle] nvarchar(max) NULL,
    [WebUrl] nvarchar(max) NULL,
    [WebDescription] nvarchar(max) NULL,
    [WebCover] nvarchar(max) NULL,
    [StartDate] datetime2 NULL,
    [EndDate] datetime2 NULL,
    [TemporaryWebCover] nvarchar(max) NULL,
    [CreatedOn] datetime2 NOT NULL,
    [UpdatedBy] uniqueidentifier NULL,
    [UpdatedOn] datetime2 NULL,
    [State] int NOT NULL,
    [CreatedBy] uniqueidentifier NULL,
    [RowVersion] rowversion NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT [PK_MainSettings] PRIMARY KEY ([Id])
);

CREATE TABLE [MainSettingsDepartmentItems] (
    [Id] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL,
    [MainSettingsId] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL,
    [IconImg] nvarchar(max) NULL,
    [ItemName] nvarchar(max) NULL,
    [ItemURL] nvarchar(max) NULL,
    [CreatedOn] datetime2 NOT NULL,
    [UpdatedBy] uniqueidentifier NULL,
    [UpdatedOn] datetime2 NULL,
    [State] int NOT NULL,
    [CreatedBy] uniqueidentifier NULL,
    [RowVersion] rowversion NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT [PK_MainSettingsDepartmentItems] PRIMARY KEY ([Id]),
    CONSTRAINT [FK_MainSettingsDepartmentItems_MainSettings_MainSettingsId] FOREIGN KEY ([MainSettingsId]) REFERENCES [MainSettings] ([Id])
);

CREATE TABLE [MainSettingsDepartmentsIcons] (
    [Id] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL,
    [MainSettingsId] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL,
    [IconImg] nvarchar(max) NULL,
    [IconName] nvarchar(max) NULL,
    [IconURL] nvarchar(max) NULL,
    [CreatedOn] datetime2 NOT NULL,
    [UpdatedBy] uniqueidentifier NULL,
    [UpdatedOn] datetime2 NULL,
    [State] int NOT NULL,
    [CreatedBy] uniqueidentifier NULL,
    [RowVersion] rowversion NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT [PK_MainSettingsDepartmentsIcons] PRIMARY KEY ([Id]),
    CONSTRAINT [FK_MainSettingsDepartmentsIcons_MainSettings_MainSettingsId] FOREIGN KEY ([MainSettingsId]) REFERENCES [MainSettings] ([Id])
);

CREATE TABLE [MainSettingsSites] (
    [Id] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL,
    [MainSetId] uniqueidentifier NULL,
    [SiteName] nvarchar(max) NULL,
    [SiteUrl] nvarchar(max) NULL,
    [OrderIndex] bigint NULL,
    [CreatedOn] datetime2 NOT NULL,
    [UpdatedBy] uniqueidentifier NULL,
    [UpdatedOn] datetime2 NULL,
    [State] int NOT NULL,
    [CreatedBy] uniqueidentifier NULL,
    [RowVersion] rowversion NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT [PK_MainSettingsSites] PRIMARY KEY ([Id]),
    CONSTRAINT [FK_MainSettingsSites_MainSettings_MainSetId] FOREIGN KEY ([MainSetId]) REFERENCES [MainSettings] ([Id])
);

    [Id] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL,
    [NameAr] nvarchar(max) NOT NULL,
    [NameEn] nvarchar(max) NOT NULL,
    [Url] nvarchar(max) NOT NULL,
    [WorkspaceKey] int NULL,
    [IsDropdown] bit NOT NULL,
    [MainSettingsId] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL,
    [State] int NOT NULL,
    [RowVersion] rowversion NOT NULL,
    [CreatedOn] datetime2 NOT NULL,
    [UpdatedBy] uniqueidentifier NULL,
    [UpdatedOn] datetime2 NULL,
